title: Resultative Sublative Phrases: pirosra süt, ropogósra pirít, puhára párol

sections.title: Expressing Resulting State with the Sublative (-ra/-re)
sections.content: In Hungarian, the sublative case (-ra/-re) attached to an adjective frequently functions as an adverbial of result (eredményhatározó). It denotes the final physical state, texture, or color attained by the object as a direct consequence of a culinary process. Instead of using a subordinate clause ('addig süti, amíg piros nem lesz'), Hungarian encapsulates the transformation succinctly: 'pirosra süti a húst' (browns/fries the meat until red/crispy).

sections.title: Common Culinary Verb-Adjective Collocations
sections.content: Common collocations include 'ropogósra pirít' (to toast until crispy), 'puhára párol' (to braise until tender), 'aranybarnára süt' (to bake until golden brown), 'sűrűre főz' (to reduce/cook until thick), 'finomra aprít' (to chop finely), and 'készre süt' (to bake until fully done). Note that the adjective always takes the sublative suffix harmonizing with its vowels (-ra after back vowels, -re after front vowels).

sections.title: Frequent Resultative Sublative Combinations
rows: A kenyérszeleteket ropogósra pirítjuk a serpenyőben. (Toast until crispy.)
A hagymát és a zöldségeket puhára pároljuk fedő alatt. (Braise until tender.)
A sütemény tetejét aranybarnára sütjük a sütőben. (Bake until golden brown.)
A gyümölcslevet lassan sűrűre főzzük a lekvárhoz. (Boil down until thick.)

items.spanish: A szakács pirosra sütötte a kacsacombokat a forró kemencében.
items.english: The chef roasted the duck legs until crisp and brown in the hot oven.

items.spanish: A vöröshagymát lassú tűzön üvegesre pároljuk, mielőtt hozzáadnánk a fűszerpaprikát.
items.english: We sweat the onion until translucent over low heat before adding the paprika.

items.spanish: A mártást addig forralták, amíg sűrűre nem főtt.
items.english: They boiled the sauce until it was reduced to a thick consistency.

items.spanish: A petrezselymet finomra aprítva szórjuk a gőzölgő húsleves tetejére.
items.english: We sprinkle the parsley finely chopped onto the top of the steaming broth.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Do not confuse the manner adverbial (-an/-on/-en: 'ropogósan tálalja') with the resultative sublative (-ra/-re: 'ropogósra pirítja'). The sublative specifies the outcome reached through the cooking process.
